commands.name: identity
argv: su -c 'getprop sys.boot_completed; getprop ro.product.device; uname -a; id; cat /proc/device-tree/model; echo; tr "\000" "\n" < /proc/device-tree/compatible'

commands.name: input-bindings
argv: su -c 'for d in /sys/class/input/input*; do echo "INPUT $d"; cat "$d/name"; readlink -f "$d/device"; readlink -f "$d/device/driver"; done'

commands.name: spi-bindings
argv: su -c 'for d in /sys/bus/spi/devices/*; do echo "SPI $d"; cat "$d/modalias"; readlink -f "$d/driver"; readlink -f "$d/driver/module"; readlink -f "$d/of_node"; ls "$d"; done'

commands.name: platform-bindings
argv: su -c 'for d in /sys/bus/platform/devices/*; do case "$d" in *ufs*|*smmu*|*gpu*|*kgsl*|*display*|*dsi*|*mdss*) echo "PLATFORM $d"; readlink -f "$d/driver"; readlink -f "$d/driver/module"; readlink -f "$d/of_node";; esac; done'

commands.name: modules
argv: su -c 'cat /proc/modules | cut -d " " -f 1-3; for d in /sys/module/*; do case "$d" in *fts*|*focal*|*touch*|*goodix*|*kgsl*|*drm*|*ufs*|*smmu*) echo "MODULE $d"; for p in version srcversion; do if test -r "$d/$p"; then echo "$p"; cat "$d/$p"; fi; done;; esac; done'

commands.name: display
argv: su -c 'for d in /sys/class/drm/* /sys/class/graphics/fb*; do test -e "$d" || continue; echo "DISPLAY $d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; for p in name modes status enabled virtual_size bits_per_pixel; do if test -r "$d/$p"; then echo "$p"; cat "$d/$p"; fi; done; done'

commands.name: gpu-storage
argv: su -c 'for p in /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_model /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_available_frequencies /sys/class/scsi_device/*/device/vendor /sys/class/scsi_device/*/device/model /sys/class/scsi_device/*/device/rev; do test -r "$p" || continue; echo "$p"; cat "$p"; done'

commands.name: kernel-config
argv: su -c 'if test -r /proc/config.gz; then zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E "^CONFIG_(TOUCHSCREEN|FTS|FOCAL|GOODIX|QCOM|SCSI_UFS|ARM_SMMU|DRM_MSM|FB_MSM|QCOM_KGSL)"; else echo "CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE"; fi'
